name: Minamiōsumi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiōsumi town emblem in blue, light blue and orange: a blue and light blue swirl of waves with an orange stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiōsumi, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 2005.
